title: Doors & Boundaries
blurb: Input Output Local · untyped skip · root rule · pure Calculate graphs.

chapters.title: Doors
chapters.text: Boundary variables are the doors of a graph. Inputs push live values into Grove State. Outputs pull answers. Locals stay inside.
chapters.deep: GraphInputData VariableKey and TypeHash. GraphOutputData adds BlobPtr DataHeader Value.

chapters.title: Root rule
chapters.text: Importer sets Root only when exactly one Input boundary connects to an execution node. Zero or two is an error if you have top level execution.
chapters.deep: CollectRootCandidates. Pure Calculate graphs may omit Root and only expose Outputs.

chapters.title: Typed I/O
chapters.text: Only typed unmanaged boundary variables become runtime Inputs and Outputs arrays on the brick.
chapters.deep: IsUntyped skips. Runtime I/O must be unmanaged. Scope sensitive names across subgraphs.

chapters.title: Untyped skip
chapters.text: Toolkit Untyped variables are fine for editor routing. They never become Graph Input Data or Graph Output Data. Silent footgun.
chapters.deep: Use typed locals or data nodes for values you need at play time.

untyped.label: Untyped

importer.label: Importer
importer.deep: Exactly one Input to execution for execution graphs.

grovestate.label: GroveState
grovestate.short: Grove State holds live door values at play.
grovestate.deep: SetInput and variable keys write here, not stack args on Root.
